items.texto: Junior schools and grassroots training with classes, fees and per-student attendance.
Full financial management, receipts and reports across disciplines.
Track students, charge fees and send receipts without the hassle.
Inclusive programmes with the same rigour in management and communication.
Publish activities and events and keep your community informed.

funcionalidades.titulo: Everything a club needs, without spreadsheets
funcionalidades.texto: From student sign-up to a receipt on WhatsApp — automated and organised per organisation.

items.texto: Complete profiles, plans, enrolment status and history — all in one place.
Automatic monthly charge generation, payment status and per-plan calculation.
PDF receipt issuing, per-organisation numbering and one-click sending.
Quick attendance per class, with training types and reports.
Automatic sending queues for receipts and notices, with retry on failure.
Monthly collected, collection rate, debtors and yearly trend in real time.
